messages:
Maya Lin: postmortem follow-up from today's DR dry-run. We saw three recurring items: 1) DNS cutover timing mismatch 2) missing cross-region snapshot tags 3) unclear replica resync verification. Need owners + ETA.
Owen Brooks: I'll take DNS cutover timing. Proposal: add an explicit pre-cutover drain + 90s wait before TTL swap. Will test in canary. ETA: 48h.
Sofia Reyes: I'll own snapshot tags and verifier. Found ~4 snapshots without replication markers. I'll add `snap-verify.sh` that lists and optionally enqueues copies. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Tom Hsu: I'll update the restore runbook with exact SQL checks for replica lag and expected rows counts. Will include sample commands and success criteria. Draft by Fri EOD.
Maya Lin: please include exact query strings and thresholds. Also create Jira epic so we can track.
OpsBot: Jira EPIC RINF-2499 created: "DR dry-run remediations" by Maya Lin.
Owen Brooks: canary plan -> run 5 control-plane flaps against `canary-eu` with traffic generator, measure failover time before/after change. I'll post results.
Sofia Reyes: PR for verifier will be at https://git.redwood/infra/snap-tools/pull/210 once ready.
Tom Hsu: runbook PR: https://git.redwood/playbooks/dr-restore/pull/78 (draft) contains CHECK_REPLICA SQL and validation steps.
Maya Lin: recap owners: Owen = DNS cutover + canary (48h), Sofia = snapshot verifier (+1d), Tom = runbook updates (+5d). I'll run weekly check-ins. :thumbsup:
